$comment: Type led covers, owner decision D283 (R285-WEB-TRANSFORMATION-WT-D, 2026-10-22). ONE source for the blog, /resources/ and the per post social card. TypeCover.astro draws the page cover from it and scripts/generate-og-images.js draws /Assets/og/blog-<slug>.png from it, so the two cannot drift. Colours are NAMES of --cover-* role tokens in astro/src/styles/tokens.css, never values. A motif is SVG on a 100 by 100 box, painted only through var(--tc-ink), var(--tc-sub) and var(--tc-accent), which the generator resolves from the same tokens. A post with no entry under posts still gets a cover: its title is the line and its category picks the family. A line here carries no comma or colon: satori sets trailing punctuation as its own segment and opens a visible gap before it on the social card. 2026-10-23, D305 lane B: a post entry is an object, `line` plus its own `motif`, so no two posts share one drawing (three posts drew the same steps, three the same rings). A plain string is still read as the line, with the family motif. The structure family moved from the night ground to mist, because one black tile among eleven light ones outweighed the posts around it.
